known_text: I'm going to ask for the same thing to eat.

use.known: I'm going to ask for the same thing as you tomorrow.
use.target: 我明天会要同样的东西。

use.known: That young man asked me if I know your brother.
use.target: 那个年轻的男人问我是不是认识你哥哥。

use.known: If the old woman can tell me, I would be very happy.
use.target: 如果那个老女人能告诉我的话，我会很开心。

use.known: Everyone told me they want to meet your sister too.
use.target: 大家都告诉我他们也想见你姐姐。

use.known: Would that young man be able to help me with this?
use.target: 那个年轻的男人能帮我做这个吗？

use.known: She hopes I can remember what the old man said.
use.target: 她希望我能记住那个老人说了什么。

use.known: I'm going to ask for the same thing tonight.
use.target: 我今天晚上会要同样的东西。

use.known: That young man said he will come to the meeting.
use.target: 那个年轻的男人说他会来开会。

use.known: If you work hard, you will be able to finish on time.
use.target: 如果你努力工作，你会按时完成。

use.known: I think she will want to see your brother tomorrow.
use.target: 我觉得她明天会想见你哥哥。

use.known: Everyone thinks we will have a good time tonight.
use.target: 大家都觉得我们今天晚上会过得开心。

use.known: Will the old woman be able to help us with this work?
use.target: 那个老女人会帮我们做这个工作吗？

use.known: I'm going to ask for the same as my father.
use.target: 我会要和我爸爸同样的东西。

use.known: That young woman wants to ask for more time.
use.target: 那个年轻的女人要更多时间。

use.known: If you want to ask for help, please do it now.
use.target: 如果你要帮忙的话，请现在做。

use.known: She told me she wants something to read.
use.target: 她告诉我她要看的书。

use.known: Everyone here wants to ask for the same thing.
use.target: 这里的大家都要同样的东西。

use.known: What do you want to ask for from your mother?
use.target: 你要你妈妈给你什么？

use.known: I'm going to ask for something good to eat tonight.
use.target: 我今天晚上会要好的东西吃。

use.known: That young woman wants something good to eat.
use.target: 那个年轻的女人想吃好的东西。

use.known: If you want something to eat, please tell us now.
use.target: 如果你想吃东西的话，请现在告诉我们。

use.known: She told me she wants to eat with your family.
use.target: 她告诉我她想和你的家人吃。

use.known: Everyone here likes to eat together after work.
use.target: 这里的大家都喜欢工作以后一起吃。

use.known: What does your father like to eat in the morning?
use.target: 你爸爸早上喜欢吃什么？

use.known: I'm going to ask for the same kind of thing to eat.
use.target: 我会要同样的东西吃。

use.known: That young man ordered the same kind as his father.
use.target: 那个年轻的男人要了和他爸爸同样的。

use.known: If you want the same kind as her, please let me know.
use.target: 如果你想和她同样的话，请让我知道。

use.known: She told me she wants the same kind as yesterday.
use.target: 她告诉我她想和昨天同样的东西。

use.known: Everyone here wants to have the same kind of answer.
use.target: 这里的大家都想有同样的答案。

use.known: Do you want the same kind of thing as your mother?
use.target: 你想和你妈妈同样的东西吗？

use.known: I'm going to ask for the same kind of thing to eat.
use.target: 我会要同样的东西吃。

use.known: That young man brought some things for your mother.
use.target: 那个年轻的男人带了一些东西给你妈妈。

use.known: If you need to buy something, please let me know.
use.target: 如果你需要买东西的话，请让我知道。

use.known: She told me there are many things to learn here.
use.target: 她告诉我这里有很多东西要学。

use.known: Everyone here likes to share things with each other.
use.target: 这里的大家都喜欢一起用东西。

use.known: What kind of things does your father like to read?
use.target: 你爸爸喜欢看什么样的东西？
